description: This file is a shell script designed for testing merge conflict scenarios in a Git repository. It sets up multiple test cases involving git operations such as branch creation, commits, merges (including conflict scenarios), and sparse checkouts to verify Git behavior.

methods.name: test_setup_numerals
methods.description: Initializes a git repository with a specific setup involving branches A and B and commits with numeral changes. Used as a common setup for multiple tests.
